title: Ticket: unique routes

ticket.subject: Route list for the board
ticket.body: The stop list has repeats. Give the board each stop once, in A to Z order.

rules: The list is in A to Z order.

title: Ticket: route pairs

ticket.subject: Legs of a trip
ticket.body: A trip visits stops in order. Give one (from, to) pair for each leg. A trip with one stop has no legs.

rules: Each leg is a (from, to) pair, in trip order.
There is one pair for each pair of neighbouring stops.
A trip with one stop gives an empty list.

title: Ticket: build a crate label

ticket.subject: Crate labels
ticket.body: A label starts with the name. Tags go in brackets, in the order given. Options come last, as key=value, sorted by key.

rules: Tags go in square brackets, in the order given, separated by ", ". No tags means no brackets.
Options are added as key=value, sorted by key.

title: Ticket: read a weight

ticket.subject: Scanner weights
ticket.body: The scanner sends weights as text. Return a float. Return None when the text is not a number. Any other input is a bug, so it must still raise TypeError.

rules: Text such as " 4.5 " gives the float 4.5.
Text that is not a number gives None.
A value that is not text raises TypeError.
